run_subtoken_score: run subtoken-level precision and recall evaluation on hypothesis and reference files for code deobfuscation
compute_subtokens: compute subtokens from a token string by converting to snake case and splitting on underscores
subtoken_counts: compute the number of precise, proposed, and ground truth subtokens from two token strings
subtoken_scores: calculate precision, recall, and F1 scores for subtoken-level comparison between proposed and ground truth tokens
subtoken_score_on_lines: evaluate subtoken precision, recall, F1, and exact match scores on lists of hypothesis and reference lines
